name: docker root filesystem filling after a canary update

evidence.text:
docker root filesystem 91 percent used
reclaimable images 14 GB, previous image of the canary service held for rollback

agent_result.diagnosis: The docker root filesystem is over the alert threshold; most reclaimable space is images, one of which is the held rollback image.
evidence: docker root filesystem is 91 percent used
suggested_actions: Prune dangling images first, keep the held rollback image until the canary window closes
